subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Date: October 15, 2021 Departure: 10:00 AM Arrival: 2:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey. Best regards, XYZ Airlines
